disambiguation.note: NAMING COLLISION HAZARD. M-MSG-TRIAGE-ROUTER already shipped internal/coordinator/triage_router.go with config key coordinator.triage, type coordinator.Decision (Hold/Promote/Drop), TriageConfig, and classify(). That is a DIFFERENT feature (local intake-inbox promotion). This sprint MUST use non-colliding names.

doc_vs_reality: Decide operates on coordinator.Message (cloud path), NOT messaging.Message. Use a feedbackgate.Input struct populated by the coordinator to avoid an import cycle.
coordinator.Message fields: Type=category, Content=body, From=sender, Inbox=routing target, Source=topic. No Contact and no IP field on the wire.
auto: is a prefix on the category attribute (publisher.go), not an auto_dispatch bool. Rule reads the auto: prefix off msg.Type.
internal/ai has native JSON mode: Request.ResponseFormat="json" + JSONSchema. Classifier injects an ai.Provider; tests use a fake (no live API).
M5 terraform (security.tf 80% alert) lives in sibling repo ailang-multivac — OUT OF SCOPE; documented follow-up handoff.
Dashboard Triage panel + --show-triage CLI flag are UI scope creep — cut to follow-up; audit data still lands in feedback-gate-audit.
IP-hash cooldown keying dropped (IP never reaches this layer; consumed at the MCP edge). Cooldown keys on From+category+bodyHash+parsed contact: line.
adopted_decisions: reject marks status=rejected + TTL(14d), does NOT delete the Firestore doc (Open Q1).
Haiku classifier skipped for internal agent-* senders (Open Q2).
Dry-run via AILANG_FEEDBACK_GATE_DRY_RUN=1: run gate, log would-be verdict, always dispatch (Open Q3).
Classifier fails CLOSED: any parse/schema/error path -> file, never dispatch.

features.notes: Commit 46dcef0bf. internal/feedbackgate created: coordinator-free Input, Verdict(dispatch/file/reject), FeedbackGateConfig, Decide. Pure rules table-tested pass+fail per rule. features.description: Wire the gate into pollAndProcessTasksCloud (cloud path only) between message loop and CreateTask. Build feedbackgate.Input from coordinator.Message. Branch dispatch/file/reject; emit feedback-gate-audit messages; markFeedbackRejected sets status=rejected (TTL, no delete). Nil-safe + opt-in (enabled=false default). Respect MODE + DRY_RUN env. Gate error -> fail closed (no CreateTask).

features.notes: Commit 66cd5de87.
